sm: Wes Huff responds to a video by Dan Mlelen that highlighted a paper he wrote in 2016 and posted on academia.edu. He says his old papers from that period are bad, with problematic citation and attribution, and he takes responsibility for them. He explains he lost access to the account in 2019, that the paper in question was an unsubmitted seminary draft, and that he treated the site like a Dropbox rather than a peer-reviewed journal. He says he reached out to the people involved and got understanding responses. Brian J. Wright, a pastor in Pensacola, Florida, appears and thanks him for contacting him, says he is not bothered by others using his work, and says Huff showed integrity. Huff adds that he has not claimed to be the number one Christian expert, that such titles were for clicks, and that he questions Dan's agenda while owning his mistakes.
